After a rare three-week wait, Apple has finally released iOS 27 beta 5 today, bringing brand-new icon designs to multiple apps including Siri and Safari.

iOS 27 Beta 5 Redesigns App Icons

iOS 27 is getting closer to its official release, which is expected next month.

This beta 5 includes a number of user-visible changes, laying the groundwork for the final version.

Several built-in apps have already received new icons:

  • Siri
  • Safari
  • Preview
  • Settings
  • Remote

You can see some of the new icons in the image above; other apps have also received minor updates.

Since the first beta, iOS 27 has been gradually refining its icon design, while Apple continues to polish the Liquid Glass aesthetic introduced last year.

Since iOS 27 beta testing began, apps such as Maps, Photos, and Wallet have gradually received new icons. However, the changes in beta 5 show that Apple has not yet finished the icon adjustments for iOS 27.

What do you think of the latest app icon changes in iOS 27? Feel free to share your thoughts in the comments section.
